name: Apollo 11
description: Apollo 11 was the first crewed mission to land humans on the Moon and return them safely to Earth.

name: Voyager 1
description: Voyager 1 explored Jupiter and Saturn and continues its mission in interstellar space.

name: Voyager 2
description: Voyager 2 explored Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune before continuing toward interstellar space.

name: James Webb Space Telescope
description: The James Webb Space Telescope studies the universe from the infrared, including early galaxies, stars and planetary systems.

name: Hubble Space Telescope
description: Hubble observes distant galaxies, stars, planets and other astronomical objects from low Earth orbit.

name: Juno
description: Juno studies Jupiter's atmosphere, magnetic field, interior and formation.

name: Europa Clipper
description: Europa Clipper is studying Jupiter's moon Europa and investigating whether conditions there could support life.

name: Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover
description: Perseverance explores Jezero Crater, studies Martian geology and collects rock and regolith samples.

name: Curiosity
description: Curiosity investigates whether Mars ever had environmental conditions capable of supporting microbial life.

name: MAVEN
description: MAVEN studies Mars' upper atmosphere and how the planet's atmosphere has changed over time.

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
description: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter studies the Martian surface and atmosphere and supports other Mars missions.

name: Mars Odyssey
description: Mars Odyssey studies the Martian surface and provides communications support for surface missions.

name: Mars Express
description: Mars Express studies the Martian surface, atmosphere and subsurface.

name: New Horizons
description: New Horizons performed the first close exploration of Pluto and continues studying objects in the Kuiper Belt.

name: OSIRIS-REx
description: OSIRIS-REx collected a sample from asteroid Bennu and returned it to Earth for scientific study.

name: Lucy
description: Lucy is exploring Jupiter Trojan asteroids to study remnants of the early solar system.

name: Psyche
description: Psyche is traveling to the metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche to investigate its composition and history.

name: DART
description: DART demonstrated asteroid deflection technology by intentionally impacting Dimorphos.

name: Parker Solar Probe
description: Parker Solar Probe studies the Sun's corona and solar wind from close range.

name: Solar Orbiter
description: Solar Orbiter studies the Sun and its solar wind while obtaining close-up observations of the solar poles.

name: Solar Dynamics Observatory
description: SDO continuously observes the Sun to understand solar activity and its effects on Earth.

name: SOHO
description: SOHO studies the Sun's interior, atmosphere and solar wind.

name: ACE
description: ACE measures particles and magnetic fields in the solar wind near the Sun-Earth L1 point.

name: GOES-U
description: GOES-U is part of the GOES-R series providing weather, environmental and space-weather observations.

name: PACE
description: PACE studies ocean health, atmospheric particles and interactions between the ocean and atmosphere.

name: SWOT
description: SWOT measures Earth's surface water and provides detailed observations of oceans, lakes and rivers.

name: NISAR
description: NISAR uses radar to study changes on Earth's land and ice surfaces.

name: Landsat 9
description: Landsat 9 continues the long-running Landsat record of Earth's changing land surfaces.

name: ICESat-2
description: ICESat-2 measures the height of Earth's ice sheets, glaciers, forests and other surfaces.

name: GRACE-FO
description: GRACE-FO measures changes in Earth's gravity field to study water movement and mass redistribution.

name: Global Precipitation Measurement
description: GPM provides global measurements of rain and snow to improve understanding of Earth's water cycle.

name: Terra
description: Terra studies Earth's atmosphere, land and oceans using multiple scientific instruments.

name: Aqua
description: Aqua studies Earth's water cycle, including precipitation, evaporation and atmospheric moisture.

name: Aura
description: Aura studies Earth's atmosphere, including ozone, air quality and climate-related gases.

name: CYGNSS
description: CYGNSS measures ocean surface winds to improve understanding and forecasting of tropical cyclones.

name: TESS
description: TESS searches for planets orbiting nearby stars by observing changes in stellar brightness.

name: Kepler / K2
description: Kepler searched for exoplanets by detecting periodic changes in the brightness of stars.

name: Chandra X-ray Observatory
description: Chandra observes X-rays from energetic objects and events throughout the universe.

name: Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope
description: Fermi observes the universe in gamma rays and studies some of the most energetic cosmic phenomena.

name: NuSTAR
description: NuSTAR observes high-energy X-rays from black holes, neutron stars and other cosmic sources.

name: NICER
description: NICER studies neutron stars and demonstrates technologies for future spacecraft navigation.

name: IXPE
description: IXPE measures the polarization of X-rays from black holes, neutron stars and other energetic objects.

name: SPHEREx
description: SPHEREx performs an all-sky spectral survey to study the origins of galaxies, stars and planetary systems.

name: Artemis I
description: Artemis I was an uncrewed test flight of the Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.

name: Artemis II
description: Artemis II is a crewed lunar mission using the Orion spacecraft to test systems and operations around the Moon.

name: International Space Station
description: The International Space Station is a multinational orbital laboratory supporting research in microgravity.

name: Galileo
description: Galileo studied Jupiter and its moons and deployed a probe into Jupiter's atmosphere.

name: Cassini-Huygens
description: Cassini-Huygens explored Saturn, its rings and moons, including the Huygens landing on Titan.

name: Dawn
description: Dawn became the first spacecraft to orbit two extraterrestrial bodies during its exploration of Vesta and Ceres.

name: MESSENGER
description: MESSENGER became the first spacecraft to orbit Mercury and studied its surface, interior and environment.

name: Magellan
description: Magellan used radar to map the surface of Venus in detail.

name: Mars Global Surveyor
description: Mars Global Surveyor mapped Mars and studied its atmosphere, surface and magnetic field.

name: Mars Pathfinder
description: Mars Pathfinder demonstrated a new landing system and deployed the Sojourner rover on Mars.

name: InSight
description: InSight studied the interior structure and seismic activity of Mars.

name: Hayabusa2
description: Hayabusa2 collected samples from asteroid Ryugu and returned them to Earth.

name: Akatsuki
description: Akatsuki was designed to study Venusian weather and atmospheric dynamics.

name: Chandrayaan-1
description: Chandrayaan-1 was India's first lunar mission and contributed important observations of the Moon.

name: Chandrayaan-2
description: Chandrayaan-2 includes an orbiter that studies the Moon from lunar orbit.

name: Chandrayaan-3
description: Chandrayaan-3 successfully demonstrated a soft landing and rover operations on the Moon.

name: Huygens
description: The Huygens probe descended through Titan's atmosphere and landed on its surface in 2005.
